llm_response.reason: The site claims to be the official source for a well-known French fashion brand (IKKS) but is registered to an undisclosed entity in Henan, China, with a domain created only in March 2025. The website mimics branding and product styles, offers aggressive promotions, and lacks any visible company information, contact details, privacy policy, or legal notice—all key scam signals. Internal navigation is sparse and there is no evidence of legitimate business operation. These characteristics match typical fake online shopping scams.
